topic: The Möbius Strip as a Non-Orientable Topological Surface

srtc.R: A 3D polygon mesh of the Möbius strip rendered using the Painter's Algorithm. Faces are colored with a teal-to-sky-blue gradient mapped to the u parameter. Depth shading simulates a diffuse light source. The current viewing angles are displayed as numeric overlays.
srtc.T: Clicking and dragging on the canvas rotates the surface in 3D by updating rotX and rotY. Releasing the mouse locks the current orientation.
srtc.C: No matter how the strip is rotated, a continuous path along its surface always returns to the starting point in a mirrored orientation, demonstrating the strip's single-sidedness.
